correctness.rationale: For fixed a,b, exact hypergeometric conditional moments of the prefix bridge under I_j=1 produce the displayed delta_j profile. Summing over j gives Cov(R,Q)=ab(N-2ab)/3 for N>=4; N=2,3 are handled explicitly. ab>=N-1 proves sign. The finite-population bridge functional limit plus hypergeometric eighth-moment bounds yields Var(T)->1/45; classical exact Var(R) then yields universal -sqrt(5) Pearson scaling. The attached standard-library exact checker passed 57,127 finite cross-checks, including an independent conditional expectation route, all compositions through N=55, and exhaustive words through N=12. Finite tests are supporting checks, not proofs.

value.rationale: The two statistics are classical distribution-free two-sample tests measuring distinct aspects of the same ranked interleaving. The exact strict negative joint covariance is not implied by marginal run or CvM laws, and the universal -sqrt(5) root-N correlation constant surprisingly ignores the limiting sample allocation. This is a motivated mixed-statistic dependence law potentially relevant to joint test calibration, not a routine restatement of a marginal variance or arbitrary finite table.
